name: Lark Karunaratne-Espinoza
location: The Narrows, sublevel 4 print den beneath a Ferrogate Transit ventilation shaft, near sub-level access near Dearborn and Jackson
description:
Dáithí looks younger than twenty-two, which has been both a professional liability and an asset. He's tall and lanky with warm brown skin, freckles scattered densely across his nose and cheeks from his Irish-Malian heritage, and hair that shifts color on a slow cycle — deep brown to auburn to near-black over the course of four hours. It's cheap geneware, the kind you get at a market stall, but he's adjusted the cycle timing himself and is unreasonably proud of this. He has ink under his fingernails permanently and smells faintly of solvent and the ozone of active print-heads.

He fell into forgery through genuine talent — he could copy letterforms by hand at age fourteen in a way that made teachers uncomfortable — and through necessity, since a Tier 1 upbringing in the Narrows offers limited other uses for that talent. He is extraordinarily good at what he does and knows it with a confidence that occasionally crosses into recklessness. He treats every document like a puzzle: the deep-substrate security threads of a Zheng-Dao transit pass, the layered biometric encoding on a Sterling-Nakamura contractor credential. He keeps a gallery of his best work photographed and stored on a dead-drop server like a portfolio. He would show it to people if he could. He is desperate to be recognized as an artist.

core_fears: Being caught not for the crime but for mediocre work
core_desires: Recognition as a craftsman — legitimate or otherwise
Enough money to get a real studio space
coping_mechanisms: Aesthetic obsession — aestheticizes everything including danger
Deflects vulnerability with humor and technical bravado
blind_spots: Underestimates the risk exposure from his photography archive
Cannot accurately assess when clients are dangerous versus merely criminal
psychology.secret: Six months ago he fabricated a full identity — birth record, employment history, biometric seed — for a woman who claimed to be fleeing a domestic situation. He charged her almost nothing. He has since seen that identity used in connection with a Ringo Corporation executive's disappearance that is all over the encrypted newsfeeds. He doesn't know if she killed the executive. He doesn't know if he should care. He knows he is implicated.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Quick, referential, slightly show-offy — drops technical printing and document-security terminology casually. Uses art criticism language applied to forgeries.
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast bursts followed by long pauses when he's actually thinking. Interrupts himself.
example_lines: 'The Sterling-Nakamura contractor pass is the most beautiful security document in the city and it is an absolute pleasure to replicate.'
'I made you a whole person. Technically speaking, you owe me an existential debt, not a financial one. The financial one is Φ800.'

story_hooks: The woman he helped has been identified and is now in Ringo Corporation custody — they are working backward through her documentation and Dáithí's print signature is traceable to anyone who knows what to look for.
A rival forger has been copying his style closely enough that Dáithí's clients are getting burned — he needs someone to help him find who's using his aesthetic and why.
narrative_function: Service provider for identity needs, potential information source on who's operating under false credentials in the city, quest giver if his work creates unexpected blowback.
augmentations: Geneware color-shifting hair (slow four-hour cycle). Retinal micro-focus implants for close detail work. Faint subdermal temperature control in fingers to prevent print-smear.
daily_life: Wakes early afternoon, works through the night on orders, takes breaks to wander the Narrows and observe faces, documents, signage — he is always studying fonts and materials. Eats badly and irregularly.
affiliation: Loosely affiliated with a Narrows print collective; takes commissions from three regular criminal brokers

decision_rules: Never meet a client in the same place twice
Don't take jobs that feel personal — personal jobs make mistakes
Price work high enough that clients treat it carefully
escalation_ladder: Polite professional decline of suspicious requests
Goes quiet and gives a false completion date to create space to think
Provides the work but builds in a subtle traceable flaw as insurance
Disappears — he has three emergency bolt-holes mapped

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Performs confidence and competence aggressively — won't let uncertainty show
interpersonal_modes.friends: Relaxes into genuine warmth, shows the work, asks for opinions, actually listens

stress_responses.medium: Goes quiet, handles objects — shuffles paper, fidgets with print tools
stress_responses.high: Fixates on a technical problem he can solve as displacement activity for the one he can't

contradictions: Talks constantly about not caring about legality but gets visibly distressed when work is used for violence rather than just deception
habits: Photographs every interesting document he encounters — menus, tickets, permits — for reference
Leaves a hair pressed into each finished document as a private signature
Talks to the print-head E.L.F. he calls the Compositor while working
breaking_points: If someone is hurt directly because of a document he made
If his archive is discovered by anyone with enforcement connections

2192 — First paid forgery job at age 14 — a student transit pass
2196 — Established print den in current location
2198 — Began taking corporate credential commissions, exponential income increase
2199 — Fabricated identity for the woman connected to the Ringo executive disappearance

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly South Asian with significant Sub-Saharan African ancestry, complemented by Hispanic/Latin American, Eastern European, and minor East Asian heritage. The genetic blend creates warm, rich brown tones with complex undertones reflecting the confluence of these diverse regions.
physical_description.build: Tall and lanky with minimal muscle definition; the posture of someone hunched over precision work for extended periods. Shoulders rounded slightly forward. Long-limbed and angular.
physical_description.hair_color: Geneware-cycled: rotates through deep brown, auburn, and near-black on a four-hour cycle; currently mid-cycle toward auburn
physical_description.hair_style: Deliberately unkempt, shoulder-length, often pulled back with whatever is at hand (wire, fabric scraps, sometimes print-ribbon)
physical_description.eye_color: Warm brown with faint iridescent shimmer at pupil edges from retinal micro-focus implants
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with golden and olive undertones from the South Asian-African-Hispanic blend, creating a rich, complex complexion that shifts subtly in different light
physical_description.complexion: Youthful face with pronounced freckles densely scattered across nose, cheeks, and upper eyelids—a striking feature from the genetic interplay of multiple heritage lines. Perpetually exhausted expression; dark circles. Fine lines around eyes from squinting at close detail work. Skin otherwise clear but marked by chronic ink stains and solvent exposure — slight dermatitis around fingertips.
distinguishing_marks: Permanent ink staining under all fingernails, arranged in layers of different pigments reflecting current and past projects
Fine chemical burn scar across the back of right hand from early geneware implant application, mostly healed but visible under certain light
Hairline stress fracture scar on left temple from a Narrows altercation at age nineteen; barely visible but palpable to touch
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Retinal micro-focus implants visible as a faint prismatic distortion in direct light when pupils dilate. Faint subdermal grid-pattern scarring on fingertips (temperature-control implants beneath). Otherwise augmentations are subtle or subcutaneous.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with the economical precision of someone accustomed to close work; careful hand placement, minimal wasted motion. When standing still, weight shifts to the balls of feet. Tendency to examine objects (walls, signage, other people's credentials) with forensic intensity. Nervous habit of rotating fingers individually as if checking for fine tremor.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4-5 Narrows aesthetic: cheap, deliberately maintained chaos. Oversized grey cotton hoodie with bleach stains and solvent discoloration; patches of lighter fabric where ink has been cleaned off. Black cargo pants with reinforced pockets weighted by tools and dead-storage drives. Scuffed leather boots resoled at least twice. Wears a modified welder's apron over everything during work — pockets filled with micro-tools, color samples, reference prints. No jewelry; one fraying paracord bracelet (salvaged). Carries a battered leather satchel (salvaged from a corpo dumpsite) containing reference materials, proof prints, and dead-drop credentials.
